declaration_verdict.note: stated (OK); relation different formulation; the auditor's reading: For reals x, L, Ux, Uxx: x*(-2 L Uxx) + (-2 L Ux) = -2L(x Uxx + Ux), i.e. the axial lag operator applied to the stress-free N_s = -2L U_X gives the second equation of (4.13).

theorem stressFree_axial_lag_algebra (x L Ux Uxx : ℝ) :
    x * (-2 * L * Uxx) + (-2 * L * Ux) = -2 * L * (x * Uxx + Ux)
